description:
[Wallet Oracle] Pre-transaction counterparty check for an EVM wallet or contract: OFAC SDN screening, GoPlus malicious-address flags (phishing, drainers, laundering, mixers ...), and a live on-chain profile (EOA / contract / EIP-7702, nonce, balance, ENS, first transaction, contract verification) — Pre-transaction counterparty check for an EVM wallet or contract: OFAC SDN screening, GoPlus malicious-address flags (phishing, drainers, laundering, mixers ...), and a live on-chain profile (EOA / contract / EIP-7702, nonce, balance, ENS, first transaction, contract verification). Returns risk_level, a plain recommendation (do_not_transact / review_before_transacting / no_red_flags_found), every reason with its source, and which sources were unavailable.

**Example:** `/v1/wallet-check?address=0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045&chain=ethereum`

chain.description: Optional. ethereum, base, arbitrum, optimism, polygon (default base).

name: wallet_check
